Package top.sywyar.pixivdownload.plugin.api.download.queue

Class QueueTaskTracker.Task

java.lang.Object
top.sywyar.pixivdownload.plugin.api.download.queue.QueueTaskTracker.Task
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
QueueTaskTracker
public static final class QueueTaskTracker.Task extends Object implements Runnable
可提交到父执行器的宿主包装器。终态后只保留 owner 字符串和宿主计数状态，不保留插件 delegate / callback。
